pr_title: Use proper types for converting Java float/double arrays in Android code
pr_body: Fixes #67574. Now converting a `double` array from Java uses `double` and `PackedFloat64Array`. I assume that the old code here was a holdover from when we had `PoolRealArray`.

issue_context.title: Cannot enable android with emulate doubles
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/2e3662acbd8586697db38569785cc9f97dff945e

### System information

Windows 11, Nvidia 3000

### Issue description

The android platform cannot enable emulate double floats.

```
platform/android/jni_utils.cpp:271:11: error: cannot initialize a variable of type 'real_t *' (aka 'double *') with an rvalue of type 'float *'
build_rd_headers(["servers/rendering/renderer_rd/shaders/effects/copy_to_fb.glsl.gen.h"], ["servers/rendering/renderer_rd/shaders/effects/copy_to_fb.glsl"])
                real_t *w = sarr.ptrw();
                        ^   ~~~~~~~~~~~
platform/android/jni_utils.cpp:287:11: error: cannot initialize a variable of type 'real_t *' (aka 'double *') with an rvalue of type 'float *'
                real_t *w = sarr.ptrw();
                        ^   ~~~~~~~~~~~
```

### Steps to reproduce

See https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/67571

### Minimal reproduction project

None

review_comments: Is there any reason why it's not `env->GetFloatArrayRegion(arr, 0, fCount, w);`, but a loop instead?
Merging the PR to fix the bug, but this might warrant a follow-up PR (CC @m4gr3d).
